name: Kushi Jewellery
areasServed: Jayanagar, JP Nagar, BTM Layout and Basavanagudi
about:
Kushi Jewellery sells necklace sets, temple jewellery, jhumkas, bangles and kadas for weddings and festivals.
This is a demo catalogue built by OneCatalog to show how a jewellery shop looks in one link. Tap a piece, then tap the WhatsApp button to ask about it.
WhatsApp messages from this demo come to OneCatalog. The address and timings are examples.
metaDescription: Kushi Jewellery demo catalogue. Necklace sets, temple jewellery, jhumkas, bangles and kadas. Ask about any piece on WhatsApp.

categoryIntros.Necklaces and Sets: Necklace sets with matching earrings, from bead chokers and kundan sets to pearl and stone collars. Pick a set and ask us on WhatsApp.
categoryIntros.Temple Jewellery: Antique gold temple jewellery with Goddess Lakshmi designs, coins, red stones and pearls, made for pujas and weddings.
categoryIntros.Earrings and Jhumkas: Jhumkas, chandbalis and studs in gold with pearls, green stones and red stones. Light to heavy, for every outfit.
categoryIntros.Bangles and Kadas: Bangles and kadas in gold with pearls, kundan, peacock designs and coloured stones. Single pairs and full stacks.
categoryIntros.Rings and Accessories: Rings, head pieces, hair clips and a small mirror box. Small pieces that finish a look.
